calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) dist_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(etl_loaded_at) mx, SUM(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) nat_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) skus,
 SUM(fs.closing_value) val, SUM(fs.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) val_recalc,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) non_phys
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category cur_cat, p.category was_cat, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, MIN(fs.closing_units) min_units, SUM((fs.closing_units<0)::INT) neg, SUM(fs.closing_value) val,
 SUM((s.store_id=129)::INT) sav, SUM((s.store_id=125)::INT) kuopio, SUM((p.valid_from > DATE '2026-06-29')::INT) newver
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (cp.category='Paint & Decorating' OR p.category='Paint & Decorating')
GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH b AS (
 SELECT cp.category AS cur_cat, p.category AS was_cat, s.store_id, fs.closing_units, fs.closing_value
 FROM fact_stock_week fs
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT cur_cat, was_cat, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores, MIN(closing_units) AS min_units, SUM(closing_value) AS val,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=129 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sav, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=125 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kuopio
FROM b WHERE cur_cat='Paint & Decorating' OR was_cat='Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY cur_cat, was_cat
